review.assessment: This change replaces the naive integer division with a remainder-distribution strategy that guarantees the returned shares sum exactly to `total_cents`, while also adding a guard against division-by-zero when `people == 0`. The implementation correctly assigns `base + 1` to the first `remainder` participants and `base` to the rest, keeping the split as even as possible. No defects were found; the logic is mathematically sound and aligns with the host's passing acceptance run.
